features.name: share_comments_addressing_op_as_you
features.definition: What proportion of the counter-argument comments use second-person direct address (e.g., you/your) to speak to the original poster?
features.spec: Parse OC_comments as a JSON list of counter-argument comments by users other than the OP. For each comment decide whether the commenter's own text directly addresses the original poster with second-person words (you, your, yours, yourself) referring to the OP or the OP's views/statements/actions. Do not count generic/impersonal 'you' (meaning people in general), 'you' inside quotations attributed to someone else unless the commenter adopts it as addressed to the OP, or text that is an OP view-change/delta-award announcement or report of the outcome. Output the number of comments with direct address divided by the total number of comments (0 to 1). Empty list gives null; missing or malformed input gives null.

h0: share_comments_addressing_op_as_you has no association with the likelihood of view change.
h1: Higher share_comments_addressing_op_as_you is associated with a higher likelihood of view change.
note: Operationalized as share of comments (rather than any/count) with direct second-person address to OP; this is an assumption. Distinguishing OP-directed from generic 'you' is semantic. Comment order/timing unknown; comments may contain outcome-related text, which is excluded from the semantic judgment. Association only, not causal.
